capabilities: Fetch page titles from pasted URLs
Convert pasted URLs to reference-style Markdown links
Convert selected URLs via a command palette command
Configure auto-conversion and placeholder text for untitled pages
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian pastes URLs as plain text or inline links, so users must manually fetch titles and format links themselves.
summary: Link converter that turns pasted URLs into reference-style Markdown links using the fetched page title.
